climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A small California AVA in the easternmost foothills of the northern Coast Range, in Solano and Yolo counties, next to the city of Winters. It has about 134 acres of vines and three wineries, growing Petite Sirah, Tempranillo, Malbec and Chardonnay.
